concerns.text: The specification defines contract schemas `model_output.schema.yaml` and `model_result.schema.yaml`, but no task in `tasks.md` references validation against these contracts. A dedicated task (e.g., “Validate model output JSON against `model_output.schema.yaml` and `model_result.schema.yaml`”) is required to ensure contract compliance.
